programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop ar y traeth - peidiwch anghofio rhoi'r eli haul arno! The Tralalas play with lots of things on the beach - what is that thing tied to a string flying in the wind.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ac mae o'n hoff iawn o'i siaced blu. Wnaiff o ei thynnu i ffwrdd cyn gwely? Pablo wants to keep his coat on, even indoors. But what about bed.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae Cen Twyn wedi bod yn gweithio ar brosiect newydd ers tro ac mae Twt ar dan eisiau gweld beth yw'r peiriant newydd. Twt can't wait to see what Cen's new machine is and what it does.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae ieir Ffermwr Ffred wedi dianc,mae'r plu yn gwneud i Llinos Llosgfynydd cosi. Mae angen help Blero. Farmer Ffred's chickens have escaped,their feathers make Llinos Llosgfynydd itch.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Tybed all Morus Y Gwynt helpu Kim a Cêt ddod o hyd i Twrch? Can Morus y Gwynt help Kim and Cêt find Twrch.

programme.title: Bwi
programme.desc: Mae Blwi angen cyngor wrth ddelio â chymydog trafferthus sy'n cadw llawer o anifeiliaid. Blwi needs advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour who has a growing number of animals.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Joni a Jini yn mynd ar nerfau ei gilydd. Ond wedi noson yng nghwmni eu cefnder annifyr, buan mae pethau'n newid. Joni and Jini get on each other's nerves but soon enough things change.

programme.title: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: 'a' am anifeiliaid fferm ac 'a' am anifeiliaid Fferm Ffoli. Today's letter is A: 'a' for anifeiliaid fferm (farm animals) & 'a' for the animals at Folly Farm.

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae Gu yn bles gyda Tad-cu am dacluso ei ddesg. Ond mae Tad-cu yn cyfaddef i Ger nage fe wnaeth! Tad-cu is in Gu's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Ger that it wasn't him.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae'r criw'n mynd i bysgota ond does gan Glynwen ddim gwialen. Mae Misha yn dangos iddi nad oes angen yr offer gorau i ddal y sgodyn mwya. The crew go fishing but Glynwen Glanhau has no rod.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Hwiangerdd draddodiadol i helpu suo plant bach i gysgu. A traditional lullaby to help little ones fall asleep.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Wrth chwilio am drysor môr-ladron, mae Wini yn darganfod wy bychan ar y traeth. As the Woohoos search for pirate treasure, Wynona finds a little egg on the beach.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn dysgu am bopeth sy'n ymwneud â cheir, ac ewn i Unol Daleithiau America i ddysgu am Henry Ford. In this episode we'll learn about cars.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto'n addo mwydod i'r Llyg i'w ddenu i barti pen-blwydd Nel Gynffonwen,ond mae'n rhoi pawb mewn perygl. Guto promises the Shrew some worms to entice him to Nel's birthday party.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Gwenllian sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Gwenllian join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Heddiw ar Newffion Alaw gydag adroddiad ar agoriad swyddogol gardd synhwyrau Ysgol Llanilar. Today on Newffion Alaw reports on the official opening of Ysgol Llanilar's sensory garden.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae Baba Gwyrdd yn weithiwr araf a phwyllog. Tybed a all ddarbwyllo Enfys i weithio'r un ffordd? Baba Gwyrdd works slowly and surely. Can Enfys be persuaded to work in the same way.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harri'n cael galwad gan Matilda yng ngorsaf yr heddlu - mae 'na broblem cwpwrdd-styc! Harri gets a call from Matilda at the police station - there's a problem with a stuck cupboard.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae Mojo a Bo yn rasio ar ôl sgwteri afreolus sy'n rheoli eu hunain! Mojo and Bo race after some runaway scooters with minds of their own.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Gwyneth Gwrtaith yn benderfynol o ymlacio ond mae swn ymhob man! Gwyneth Gwrtaith is determined to relax but noises from all directions disturb her peace.

programme.title: Yr Whws

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Daring Ashique
programme.desc: Cheenu, a studious boy, and Lakshmi, the village landlord's daughter, study in the same college and fall for each other. However, her brother-in-law covets her and poses problems for the couple.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: A crook and his unhinged brother take a preacher's family hostage and cross the border into Mexico. They head to a rough strip club to make a planned rendezvous with a third party - but they soon have to live on their wits when they realise that the establishment's staff are vampires. Horror, starring George Clooney, Harvey Keitel, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: 47 Metres Down
programme.desc: Two sisters vacationing in Mexico are trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean. With less than an hour of oxygen left and great white sharks circling nearby, they must fight to survive. Horror, starring Mandy Moore, Claire Holt and Matthew Modine.

programme.title: Die Alone
programme.desc: A young couple flee the city during a zombie outbreak, only to be involved in a car crash. When the man awakes, his girlfriend is missing, so he bands together with a rugged survivalist to find his partner - but he only has selected memories of what he has been through. Apocalypse drama, starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Douglas Smith, Frank Grillo and Kimberley-Sue Murray.

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: A family become convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs. Steven Soderbergh's horror thriller, starring Lucy Liu, Chris Sullivan, Callina Liang and Eddy Maday.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.desc: When an experimental military weapon accidentally devastates Tasmania, volunteers travel to the island to help authorities identify the dead. Among them is a Ava Newman, who secretly hopes to find her missing husband. However, some of the bodies seem to be returning to life. Horror, starring Daisy Ridley, Brenton Thwaites and Mark Coles Smith.

programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.desc: A year after their friend disappeared, a group find themselves trapped in a time loop, where they are hunted and killed unless they survive until dawn. Video game-inspired horror, starring Ella Rubin, Michael Cimino and Odessa A'zion.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Decades since the rage virus took hold, the survivors live on a small island. When one of the group leaves on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors. Danny Boyle's horror thriller sequel, starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ralph Fiennes and Rocco Haynes.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them. Supernatural horror, starring Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Natalie Grace.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.
